opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell homes, my name is uh Sanne. How can I help?
opening.comment: The agent gave their own name and the company name in the opening greeting, which meets the standard.

verification.quote: Can I take your full names and your older number or postboard, please?
verification.comment: Verification was requested before the agent looked up the order, which is correct, though the caller's full name and order number were then given and accepted.

understanding.quote: So i you're asking when the €81.00 will bee back on your card?
understanding.comment: The agent correctly captured the refund question and confirmed the issue with the caller before answering.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Refunds are paids within 5 working days off the return arriving, uh so it will be on you're card within 5 working days from yesterday.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy says the refund is paid within 5 working days of arrival, so the timeline was stated correctly, but the agent should have said the refund is paid within the window rather than promising it will be on the card within that period, which the bank may take longer to show.

process_compliance.quote: Can I you on hold it for a moment while I and check the refund is queued?
process_compliance.comment: The agent asked permission before the hold and thanked the caller on return, as required.

communication.quote: Thank you it for waiting. It's queued, and you'll get an email the day it's paids.
communication.comment: The agent was polite and thanked the caller for waiting, with no frustration expressed that needed acknowledging.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and closed politely, but did not clearly confirm the next step with the caller beyond saying the refund is queued.
